notes: A redesigned Android app. The sign-in screen, the dashboard, the asset list, the side menu and Settings have been rebuilt around cards, soft fields and pills, and they take their accent from your server's own branding rather than the bundled red. The dashboard leads with how much of the register is out with somebody, shows four of each list with a "See all" link to the screen that owns it, and the side menu no longer repeats what is already in the bottom bar. Dark mode is fixed: the new screens were falling back to the light palette and coming out white.
